items.sourceEvidence: 50ms is not a measured device-independent guarantee; DPI is printing characteristic
items.resolution: Treat as performance target and measure real hardware, cached revocation freshness

items.issue: Council automatic authority in LGA profile webcopy
items.sourceEvidence: Many 774 profiles say council retains 100% statutory authority over vital registrations; competence varies by source/State/FCT law
items.resolution: Replace with authority-of-record language, NPC statutory control and separate court/land/health mandates

items.issue: CFRN s.121(3) and SC/CV/343/2024 automatic escrow rule
items.sourceEvidence: Different fiscal provisions; zero escrow is NigeriaStack engineering policy, not quoted judicial rule covering all statutory fees
items.resolution: Distinguish Court judgment on LGA allocations, s121(3) state judicial/legislative finance and enabling fee laws

items.issue: Evidence Act 2011 s84 final legal proof
items.sourceEvidence: Evidence (Amendment) Act 2023 changes relevant electronic-record provisions; cryptographic signature not automatic admissibility
items.resolution: Keep device provenance as evidence aid, require counsel/authority review and qualified admissibility statement

items.issue: NDPA s37 as agent delegation authorization
items.sourceEvidence: Section addresses significant solely automated decisions, not standalone mandate for autonomous AI
items.resolution: Human countersign, lawful basis, contestability and independent mandate check

items.issue: Salted NIN hashes called zero-knowledge identity
items.sourceEvidence: A salted hash alone is not a ZK proof and may be guessable or correlatable
items.resolution: Use issuer-signed claims and verifiable selective disclosure; cryptographic ZK only with validated protocol

items.issue: USSD/offline paid receipt before bank confirmation
items.sourceEvidence: v2.4 wording risks treating assessment/QR ticket as settled while network is down
items.resolution: Provisional intent only; bank-signed confirmation and independent ledger match required for final receipt

items.issue: Escrowed WASH operator tariff release in Pillar D
items.sourceEvidence: Conflicts with no escrow of public statutory principal; private contractor arrangements distinct
items.resolution: Separate public tariff from lawful private contractual payment, enforce no public-principal escrow

items.sourceEvidence: No NCC allocation/operator agreements supplied
items.resolution: Conditional adapter; disable live dialing claims, require allocation evidence and per-MNO testing

items.sourceEvidence: Court may be geographically in LGA but judge, registrar and docket are judicial authorities
items.resolution: Route case writes only to court-controlled issuer; council only locator

items.sourceEvidence: Council intake does not itself create official NPC birth/death registration
items.resolution: Request/notification and authoritative NPC reconciliation separate from official extract

items.issue: DIGITECO JSON-LD vs baseline NigeriaStack publisher
